# Freight Floor

> Freight Floor (https://freightfloor.com) is a free, arcade-style multiplayer forklift game that runs in the browser. Players drive forklifts on a shared, isometric warehouse floor, picking up and delivering pallets against rival forklifts driven by Google Gemini AI agents. It is open source (Apache-2.0) and built by Davenporter (https://davenporter.com).

## Gameplay

- 3-Minute Blitz (default): a personal high-score run. The clock starts on your first move.
- Free Range: open-ended driving, ranked by points per real minute (PPM) and on-time percentage.
- Contract cards: each run deals 3 goal cards. Completed cards give perks such as speed, reach or battery efficiency.
- AI fleet: rival forklifts follow Sprinter, Steady, Batcher, Opportunist and Strategist archetypes, with decisions from Gemini on Vertex AI.
- Four regional warehouse sites (Denver, Salt Lake City, Phoenix, Albuquerque) that hand pallets to each other.
- Floor mode: spectators watch the shift, see KPIs and send floor orders to the AI fleet.
- Controls: WASD to drive, E to pick up or drop, Shift to boost, C for Co-Pilot, Tab for standings, ? for help.

- [Architecture](https://github.com/davenportjw/freightfloor/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Cloud Run lobby and regional site shards, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI
